text:
erin: FYI we're preparing a region-by-region roll for release redwood-2.4.1 during the 0200 UTC night window. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary default 4% with 10m pin.

sam: I'll run a fast headroom & queue check and post numbers.

infra-bot: Preflight running...

infra-bot: Preflight results:
US: free GPUs 142/180 (78%), queues low
EU: free GPUs 84/110 (76%), queues low
APAC: free GPUs 34/70 (48%), queues moderate

jia: APAC under 60%. Options: warm-pool +4, reduce APAC canary to 1%, or delay APAC to the next window. Night window gives us more flexibility but warmpool might take ~7m.

erin: Let's warm APAC +4 now and start US canary. If warmup still <65% at APAC time, we go 1% canary + extended pin 15m. Agreed?

sre-liz: Agreed. Also set rollback triggers: error_rate >0.4% sustained 3m or p95 >1.8x baseline for 2m. That should catch regressions early.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by erin. release=redwood-2.4.1 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.04 pin=10m rollback=[error>0.4%:3m,p95>1.8x:2m] Use `/deploy status 1766547777` to follow.

sam: Warmpool +4 in APAC requested. ETA ~6m. Starting US canary now. `/deploy start --release redwood-2.4.1 --region us --canary 0.04 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: US canary started (slice s-811). Obs: https://console/redwood/obs/s-811

sre-liz: Watching US. p95 +9ms, error_rate steady at 0.01%. No action.

sam: US pin window done and green. Kicking EU. `/deploy start --release redwood-2.4.1 --region eu --canary 0.04 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: EU canary started (s-812).

infra-bot: APAC warm-pool done: new free GPUs 44/74 (59%). Still below 65% threshold.

jia: APAC still <65%. Switching APAC config to canary 1% and pin 15m as discussed. `/deploy update 1766547777 --region apac --canary 0.01 --pin 15m`

deploy-bot: APAC canary updated. Starting APAC canary (s-813) at 1%.

deploy-bot: :warning: s-813 shows a kv_cache_miss spike at +4m (1.4%) and small bump in 500s.

sre-liz: Tracing points to apac-gpu-21 reporting `ShardNotFoundError` in kv router. Initiating rollback for s-813. `/deploy rollback --slice s-813 --reason "ShardNotFoundError apac-gpu-21"`

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for s-813. APAC pin released and traffic reverted.

erin: Good catch. Hold APAC. Actions: infra to isolate apac-gpu-21 and run config-sync; jia to run staging repro against shard map; sam to prepare a hotfix plan (config push + rolling restart). Opening INC-2026-320 with links.

jia: I'll add the repro steps and a short checklist for next attempt (smoke in staging, canary at 0.5% then 1% if stable).

sre-liz: Also recommend adding a temporary route rule so future APAC small canaries avoid apac-gpu-21 until it's validated.

erin: Agreed. Summarizing: US/EU rolled successfully to v2.4.1, APAC canary failed and was rolled back due to shard error. Holding APAC until repair. Incident INC-2026-320 created. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
